intro.en: Read a short exchange and notice how people ask for a change politely.

titulo.en: A polite request has two parts

texto.en:
Use **¿Podría…?** or **¿Sería posible…?** to make a request more formal. Give the reason briefly, then say what you would prefer: **¿Podría cambiar la fecha? Me gustaría conservar la misma habitación**.

The other person can offer an option, explain a limit or ask a question. Check the details before agreeing: dates, price and what is included. These phrases are useful in a hotel, but the same pattern works for appointments and bookings.

frases.en: —Good morning. Could you help me with a booking?
—Of course. What name is it under?

frases.es: —A nombre de Elena Ruiz. Quería cambiar la fecha: en vez del viernes, llegaría el sábado.
frases.en: —Under Elena Ruiz. I wanted to change the date: instead of Friday, I would arrive on Saturday.

frases.es: —Déjeme comprobarlo. La misma habitación está disponible, pero tendría que pagar un suplemento de veinte euros.
frases.en: —Let me check. The same room is available, but you would have to pay a surcharge of twenty euros.

frases.es: —¿Podría decirme si el desayuno está incluido?
frases.en: —Could you tell me whether breakfast is included?

frases.es: —Sí, se conserva. Si le parece bien el precio, cambio la fecha ahora mismo.
frases.en: —Yes, it stays included. If the price is all right with you, I can change the date now.

To arrive on Saturday instead of Friday.en: She asks to move her arrival by one day.

To change to a different room.en: She would like to keep the same room.

To cancel breakfast.en: She asks whether breakfast is included.

bloques.correcta: To arrive on Saturday instead of Friday

pregunta.en: What extra cost does the change involve?
What does the receptionist mean by «Si le parece bien el precio»?

The change will happen if Elena accepts.en: The receptionist is checking that she agrees before changing the date.

The price may change again tomorrow.en: No later price change is mentioned.

Elena must pay for breakfast.en: The text says breakfast is included.

bloques.correcta: The change will happen if Elena accepts the price

pregunta.en: Complete the polite request: could you tell me?

bloques.frase: ¿___ decirme si el desayuno está incluido?

Puedo.en: This asks whether I can do it.

bloques.frase: ¿Sería posible cambiar la fecha de la reserva?

traduccion.en: Would it be possible to change the booking date?
